description: Proud to be endorsed by the Business Council of New York State PAC!As one of the few small business owners in the legislature, I’ve made it my mission to advocate for our job creators and to provide a private sector perspective on the many bills and proposals that flow through Albany. Our business community is the economic engine that drives New York forward and they will always have a champion in me.
